title: Shout it
description:
Read one line of text and print three lines: the text in capitals followed by `!`, its length in bytes, and the text written twice with ` - ` between.

```
Word? lua
LUA!
3
lua - lua
```

solution.main.lua:
io.write("Word? ")
local word = io.read()
print(word:upper() .. "!")
print(#word)
print(word .. " - " .. word)

hints: `word:upper()` gives a capitalised copy; `#word` its length; `..` joins strings.

examples.name: two words
examples.expected:
Word? HELLO THERE!
11
hello there - hello there

tests.name: two words
tests.expected:
